description: This Java source file defines utility methods for handling key-value entries, including validation, conversion, and filtering functions within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: KvUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for validating, converting, and filtering key-value entries in the system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a list of KvEntry objects for key and value correctness, including XSS validation if specified.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a single KvEntry object for key correctness and optional value validation.

methods.name: toTsKvEntryList
methods.description: Converts a map of timestamp to list of KvEntry objects into a list of TsKvEntry objects.

methods.name: filterChangedAttr
methods.description: Filters and returns attributes that have changed compared to current attributes, based on value or data type differences.
